title: Trace form
description: A captured form: its pages and elements, the fields found on it, the form as a conversation, the values dictated into the fields, hints, and what a person decided. Version 2b-0.3 (draft, 2026-10-11).

id.description: the job this file belongs to, assigned by the app

form.description: The form as a document, independent of this filling

language.description: language of the printed form; dictation is mapped into this language

origin.description: original: the published form unchanged; rebuilt: our own layout with the same fields

after.description: for a rebuilt form: the form it follows (name and publisher)

file.description: path of the PDF relative to the data folder

own.description: the id under which the form of this job is kept as a form of its own, to be chosen and filled in again: set when a person saved a captured form or corrected one by hand

language.description: the language of the person who fills in, when it is not form.language: the dialogue is asked and answered in it, and the values are translated into form.language before sending

width.description: pixels at 300 dpi; every x, y, width, height below refers to this

unit.description: character height of the page in pixels, as measured

blocks.description: every element the geometry found, unchanged; fields point at them

fields.description: what can be filled in, in reading order

dialogue.description: the form as a conversation: one question per unit of fields, in the order of the paper; built once when the form is captured

model.description: the model that wrote and checked the questions; null when none was asked

units.description: q1, q2, … in the order of the conversation; every field except the signature belongs to exactly one unit

kind.description: single: one field; choice: tick marks that belong together; table: rows built alike

fields.description: ids of the fields an answer to this unit goes into

label.description: the printed labels of the unit's fields; what is asked where no question holds

repeat.description: for a table: its rows are entries of one list, each row with the same labels column by column; asked one entry at a time, and a row nothing stands in is not shown

parts.description: for a table of one row: its three fields are the day, the month and the year of one date; asked once, the answer read as a date and put into them by code

question.description: the plain question, present only when it passed the check: every run named this unit, and no other unit of the page is asked with the same words

skip.description: not asked: the fillable original has no form field at this place

required.description: the form requires what is entered here: an entry of the form's catalogue marked required was bound to this unit, by the label of a field or by the model with a check back

by.description: the question was written by a person; it stands as it is and is not checked

translations.description: the dialogue in other languages than the form's, by language; made once when the form is first opened in that language

question.description: the unit's question in this language, present only when the translation passed the same check as the question itself

label.description: the unit's printed label in this language; asked where no question holds

options.description: for a choice: the label of each option in this language, by field id

values.description: the values of the unit's fields in this language, by field id, in the order of fields[].values

audio.description: the dictation, as recorded on the device

language.description: language spoken; may differ from form.language

pieces.description: number of pieces the recording was cut into at silence

transcript.description: what the model heard, piece by piece; raw and untouched. A typed answer to a question is a piece without sound

start.description: seconds from the start of the recording

text.description: transcript after number words were turned into digits

raw.description: transcript exactly as the model returned it

approve.description: a person should listen: the piece was empty, cut off, or the model switched language

question.description: id of the dialogue unit this piece was said or typed in reply to

row.description: for a reply to a list of entries: the first row of the table its entries went into, counted from 1

status.description: where the form stands in the flow

history.description: what happened to this form, in order

block.description: one element of a page, as the geometry and the reading step produced it

id.description: b1, b2, … in reading order over the whole form

content.description: text read from the element; for checkbox and radio "x" when ticked, otherwise empty

isOCR.description: the content was read from the image, not taken from a text layer

approve.description: a person should look: the rendered text does not match the image

label.description: the printed label next to or above the field

kind.description: what the field takes; a value is written and checked by code the way its kind asks for

kindBy.description: who named the kind where the geometry did not: the model proposed it, or a person set it in the mask; a kind a person set is never proposed anew

labelBlock.description: id of the block that carries the label

boxBlock.description: id of the block that is the input, checkbox or radio

group.description: radios that exclude each other share a group name

option.description: for a radio or checkbox: what ticking it means, from its label

values.description: the values a writing field may take, in the language of the form, set by the person who keeps the form; such a field takes one of them or stays empty

required.description: must carry a value before sending; from the catalogue

widget.description: name of the PDF form field this field writes into, when the PDF is fillable

value.description: what was dictated or entered; for checkbox and radio "x" or empty

by.description: the field was put on the page by a person, not found by the pipeline

source.description: where a value came from and whether a person should look at it

piece.description: transcript piece the value was taken from

quote.description: the words in the transcript the value rests on

how.description: literal: the value stands in the transcript as is; derived: every word of it does, in another order; cited: the model named the piece but the words are not there; composed: the model phrased it; chosen: the model picked it from the field's values and the entry does not stand in the transcript; entered: a person typed or picked it

approve.description: a person should look: not literal or derived, or the piece carries approve

said.description: what the person gave in their own language, before the value was translated into the language of the form

check.description: why code flags the translation: the digits differ, it differs from what was said by a character or two, or nothing came back

review.description: what a person did with the value

rule.description: id of a general rule, when the change came from one or founded one

hint.description: something a person should check before sending; the program never says "not allowed"

kind.description: missing: required field empty (code); vague: the model found the entry insufficient against the catalogue; incomplete: the model found that the answer does not cover what the question asks for; legal: the catalogue's requirement for this field; format: the value does not fit the kind (code); double: the same value came out of a dictation in one go into two fields (code)

suggestions.description: on a vague hint for a field without values: passages of what was said that may fit instead, each standing in the transcript as is

article.description: legal reference as printed in the catalogue, e.g. SchKG Art. 67 Abs. 1 Ziff. 3

catalogue.description: catalogue file and its validation stamp
